photo.credit: NASA · Near-Rectilinear Halo Orbit (NRHO) — the Artemis-era reference orbit for the Lunar Gateway. The orbit stays close to the lunar south-polar region, minimises eclipse durations, and is dynamically stable enough to be maintained with low-ΔV station-keeping.
